sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate is semantically faithful and deterministicValidation.valid is true. It preserves the ship-owned target, known-versus-unknown alternatives, QUDT quantity-node structure and declared units, Table 6-9 controlled reference, required lookup relationships and evidence artifact, and an explicit same-case comparison proving diameter equals the lookup input and speed equals the selected lookup result. Freeze for later RDF evaluation.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the lookup alternative: do not require nltl:propellerRotationalSpeedAtMaximumContinuousRatingBollard unconditionally while merely requiring a lookup case. The false branch must represent the Table 6-9 selection by requiring the canonical nltl:lookupResultQuantity on the tableLookupCase and constraining the ship's propeller-speed quantity to that selected result (with an explicit comparison/query). Otherwise an arbitrary speed plus a diameter-matching lookup case passes without proving that the speed was selected from Table 6-9. Preserve the ship-owned targets, diameter-input comparison, and known/unknown alternatives. Also remove the lookupSelectionEvidence/evidenceArtifact requirement unless it is intended to be an explicitly declared obligation; dependencyContract.evidenceTerms is empty, although the relationship is listed.

Deterministic validation prevents acceptance. Fix: Unknown canonical benchmark IRI(s): https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#TRF085Shape | COMPLETE dependency relationship(s) absent from candidate: lookupSelectionEvidence
Semantic validator feedback: REVERSAL: The prior instruction to omit lookupSelectionEvidence is superseded by the COMPLETE dependency contract, which explicitly declares lookupSelectionEvidence as a required relationship; add that path from each tableLookupCase to an evidenceArtifact and constrain its required evidence role. Preserve the existing known/unknown alternatives, ship-owned diameter and speed, Table 6-9 reference, diameter-to-lookup-input comparison, and speed-to-lookup-result comparison. Also remove or replace the unknown canonical IRI nltl:TRF085Shape; use a valid non-vocabulary shape identifier or locate the canonical benchmark shape term. The candidate cannot freeze while deterministicValidation.valid is false.

Deterministic validation prevents acceptance. Fix: Quantity property propellerRotationalSpeedAtMaximumContinuousRatingBollard must point to a QUDT QuantityValue node, not a direct literal datatype | Quantity property propellerRotationalSpeedAtMaximumContinuousRatingBollard must point to a QUDT QuantityValue node, not a direct literal datatype | Quantity property propellerDiameter must point to a QUDT QuantityValue node, not a direct literal datatype
Semantic validator feedback: Repair the deterministic datatype/unit failure: remove sh:datatype qudt:QuantityValue from every ship-owned quantity property shape for nltl:propellerRotationalSpeedAtMaximumContinuousRatingBollard and nltl:propellerDiameter, because these properties must point to QUDT QuantityValue nodes, not datatype literals. Retain the nested sh:node/sh:class qudt:QuantityValue constraints and their declared units. Preserve the known/unknown alternatives, ship-owned diameter and speed, Table 6-9 tableReference, tableLookupCase-owned lookupInputQuantity and lookupResultQuantity, lookupSelectionEvidence to evidenceArtifact, and the explicit comparison proving diameter equals the lookup input and speed equals the selected lookup result. Do not add guessed units or activate the vocabulary matcher.

The candidate is semantically faithful and deterministicValidation.valid is true. It preserves the ship-owned target, known-versus-unknown alternatives, QUDT quantity-node structure and declared units, Table 6-9 controlled reference, required lookup relationships and evidence artifact, and an explicit same-case comparison proving diameter equals the lookup input and speed equals the selected lookup result. Freeze for later RDF evaluation.
